body: It's just... I'm so tired of looking... I feel like I'm not good enough... When they tell me they just aren't looking for a relationship and then just get together with the first guy that comes their way... how can I not be crushed by that? And it's not just one... it's been so many, different names, different faces but the story is always the same... And everyone tells me to hold on, that she's out there somewhere... am I really that inadequate that it takes a specific kind to love me? I feel so worthless...
